title: Core Banking authority map: Account → Payments → Ledger
summary: Core/Retail Banking is three queue-addressable authorities. Account owns customer/account/beneficiary lifecycle; Payments owns customer transaction and reservation authority; Ledger owns balances, holds, postings, atomic commit and durable monetary receipts.
invariants: Account Engine has no transfer method and no balance/posting API.
Payments may authorise a payment or hold but cannot alter monetary truth.
Ledger alone owns postings, balances, holds/reservations and SQL monetary truth.
The ordinary channel principal has no direct PUT access to the Ledger command queue.
Final customer outcomes are published only after Ledger commit.

provenance.claim: Account, Payments and Ledger ownership boundaries.
